mainEntity.name: How is local SEO different from general SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: General SEO aims to improve a website's visibility for national or global search terms, focusing on broad keywords and overall domain authority. Local SEO, however, specifically targets customers within a defined geographic area. It emphasizes local search queries, Google Maps results, and location-specific keywords, leveraging tools like Google Business Profile to connect businesses with nearby customers.
acceptedAnswer.description: General SEO targets national/global visibility, while local SEO focuses on attracting customers within a specific geographic area using local search queries and tools.
